description.value: Grain Tasting Bar is the cocktail and spirits bar located within the Hyatt Regency Vancouver, situated at the corner of Burrard and Georgia in the heart of downtown. It occupies a prime position close to the Burrard Bridge cycling corridor and Vancouver's waterfront seawall, making it a convenient stop for cyclists exploring the city centre. The bar focuses on a curated selection of spirits and drinks in a smoke-free, indoor setting within a full-service hotel.
